code_issues.explanation: clamp() never checks that lo <= hi. With lo > hi, pmax() raises every value to lo and pmin() then lowers it to hi, so the result is hi everywhere without any error.
code_issues.summary: clamp() silently returns hi everywhere when lo > hi instead of stopping.

tests.description: clamp keeps values inside the range
clamp stops when lo is above hi

failures.explanation: The test expects an error for lo > hi, which is the sensible contract; clamp() has no such check and returns hi instead.
